purpose: Prevent Portfolio Risk / Trading Frictions research from inferring a Taiwan stock transaction-tax class from signal timing or incomplete execution evidence.
evidenceHierarchy: ACTUAL: broker statement/import or verified external record directly reports transaction tax amount.
MODELED VERIFIED_DAY_TRADE_ELIGIBLE: actual same-account/same-symbol/same-day buy+sell fills plus independently verified day-trade eligibility; rate must still be date-valid official/broker rule.
MODELED ORDINARY_STOCK_SALE: Taiwan stock sell fill plus positively false day-trade reduced-tax eligibility; rate must be date-valid official rule.
UNKNOWN: tax class/eligibility not positively evidenced.
prohibitions: BUY and SELL signals on the same date do not establish day-trade tax treatment.
Same-day fills without verified eligibility do not automatically establish reduced tax treatment.
Current legal rate must not be applied backward to a historical trade without date validation.
Modeled tax must not be labeled ACTUAL.
UNKNOWN tax must not be coerced to ordinary or reduced rate.
